name: promptlanx
description: Blocks prompts that contain API keys, tokens or hard-coded passwords before they are sent to Claude. Runs locally: no network calls, no storage, no logging of prompt text.

disabled_providers.title: Key formats to switch off
disabled_providers.description: Built-in key formats PromptLanx should NOT block, separated by commas. Any of: labelled, openai, anthropic, aws, github, google, stripe, slack. Leave empty to check them all. Passwords and tokens (password = …) are always checked.

custom_key_formats.title: Your own key formats
custom_key_formats.description: Extra key formats to block, separated by commas, each written prefix:min-max. Example: acme_live_:24-40 blocks keys starting with acme_live_ followed by 24 to 40 letters, digits, _ or -. Prefix: 3-40 of A-Z a-z 0-9 _ . -; lengths 8-256; at most 20 formats.
